mapper.sql: SELECT s.course_id, c.title AS course_title, c.classification_code, s.signal, s.signalled_at FROM ( SELECT i.course_id, 'INTEREST' AS signal, i.created_at AS signalled_at FROM tb_course_interests i WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT e.course_id, 'ENROLLMENT', e.applied_at FROM tb_enrollments e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND (e.status IN ('APPLIED', 'WAITLISTED', 'APPROVED') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_completions cp WHERE cp.enrollment_id = e.id AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED')) ) s JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = s.course_id WHERE c.classification_code IS NOT NULL

c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'RECRUITING' AND (c.recruit_start_date IS NULL OR c.recruit_start_date <= #{filter.today}) AND (c.recruit_end_date IS NULL OR c.recruit_end_date >= #{filter.today}) AND (c.capacity IS NULL OR c.capacity + COALESCE(c.waitlist_capacity, 0) > (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_enrollments en WHERE en.course_id = c.id AND en.status IN ('APPROVED', 'WAITLISTED')))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_course_interests i WHERE i.user_id = #{filter.userId} AND i.course_id = c.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_enrollments en WHERE en.user_id = #{filter.userId} AND en.course_id = c.id AND (en.status IN ('APPLIED', 'WAITLISTED', 'APPROVED') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_completions cp WHERE cp.enrollment_id = en.id AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED')))
AND NOT (COALESCE(c.target_audiences, '') <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(string_to_array(c.target_audiences, ',')) AS t(code) WHERE t.code NOT IN ('CHILDREN', 'YOUTH')))
AND c.id NOT IN
#{excludedId, javaType=java.util.UUID, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler}
mapper.select: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.institution_id, c.title) s.course_id, s.score, s.top_factor, c.recruit_end_date FROM tb_course_recommendation_scores s JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = s.course_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND ORDER BY c.institution_id, c.title, c.recruit_end_date ASC NULLS LAST, s.score DESC ) -- 재학습 전의 옛 점수 행에 REGION 이 남아 있을 수 있다. 다음 학습에서 교체된다. SELECT course_id, score, CASE WHEN top_factor = 'REGION' THEN 'POPULARITY' ELSE top_factor END AS top_factor FROM ranked ORDER BY score DESC, recruit_end_date ASC NULLS LAST, course_id LIMIT #{limit}

WITH ranked AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.institution_id, c.title) c.id AS course_id, cl.code AS classification_code, cl.name AS classification_name, COALESCE(p.score, 0) AS score, c.recruit_end_date FROM tb_courses c JOIN tb_course_classifications cl ON cl.code = left(c.classification_code, 7) || '0000' LEFT JOIN tb_course_popularity p ON p.course_id = c.id AND p.segment_type = 'ALL' AND p.segment_key = '*' AND p.window_days = #{windowDays} WHERE cl.code IN #{code} AND ORDER BY c.institution_id, c.title, c.recruit_end_date ASC NULLS LAST, COALESCE(p.score, 0) DESC ) SELECT course_id, classification_code, classification_name FROM ranked ORDER BY score DESC, recruit_end_date ASC NULLS LAST, course_id LIMIT #{limit}
